name: Comment form validation and Customization
author: Chetan Vaghela

sections.description:
Comment Form Validation & Customization improves the default WordPress comment form by adding client-side validation, enhancing the user experience, and providing additional customization options.

Instead of displaying the default WordPress “die” page when an error occurs (such as submitting a duplicate comment), the plugin shows user-friendly validation and error messages directly below the comment form. This helps visitors correct issues without leaving the current page.

The plugin also allows you to customize the comment form submit button text to better match your website’s style.

Features

  • Add JavaScript validation for required comment form fields.
  • Display validation errors without reloading the page.
  • Prevent the default WordPress “die” page on comment submission errors.
  • Display duplicate comment messages below the comment form.
  • Customize the comment form submit button text.
  • Improve the overall comment submission experience.
  • Lightweight and easy to configure.

Use Cases

  • Improve the user experience during comment submission.
  • Reduce visitor frustration caused by the default WordPress error page.
  • Provide clear validation messages before form submission.
  • Customize the appearance and wording of the comment form.
  • Create a smoother commenting experience for your visitors.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Open Comment Form Customization from the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Configure the available options according to your requirements.
  5. Save your settings.
sections.faq:
Does this replace the default WordPress comment form?

No. The plugin enhances the existing WordPress comment form without replacing it.

What happens when a visitor submits a duplicate comment?

Instead of displaying the default WordPress error page, the plugin shows a user-friendly message below the comment form.

Can I change the submit button text?

Yes. The plugin allows you to customize the comment form submit button label from the settings page.

Does the plugin require any coding?

No. Simply install, activate, and configure the plugin from the WordPress admin dashboard.
